campaign.portfolio_description: Postpaid mobility customers targeted for Add-A-Line cross-sell

include.logic: Include customers where LOB_DESC = 'Telus Postpaid' AND SUB_STATUS = 'A' (active subscribers on the TELUS postpaid line of business)
Include only primary subscribers where Primary_Sub > 0

Include customers scored in the FDA current model score master table where PREDICT_MODL_ID = 2008, CLASSN_NM = 'ADD_A_LINE', and SEG_NM is one of reco_1 through reco_5, using the most recent PART_LOAD_DT partition
Include only customers whose preferred language is French (language code = 'FR')

include.term: Prioritize highest reco when cutting the list
include.logic: Sort the final audience by AAL recommendation segment ascending (reco_1 first through reco_5 last) and apply list cut based on this sort order

exclude.term: Remove those added a line in the past 60 days
exclude.logic: Exclude customers who have had a new line activation on their BAN within the past 60 days

exclude.term: Standard exclusions — Credit Classes L, C, E, V, X, K
exclude.logic: Exclude customers whose credit class is one of L, C, E, V, or X or K (Standard_Exclusions = 0 AND credit class NOT IN ('L','C','E','V','X','K'))
exclude.threshold: Credit Classes L, C, E, V, X, K

exclude.logic: Exclude customers assigned to the Universal Control Group holdout per Adobe template

contact_strategy_override.condition: Contact strategy applied per template; distribution list includes dlCSSWLSListDeliveryGroup@telus.com, ti.dialer@telusinternational.com, Jenny Olsen, Michael El Hage

segmentation.geography: Quebec customers with English as preferred language should receive a bilingual version per OQLF compliance requirement

SFTP delivery path references both TI SFTP and a PL Telecom path — delivery routing for each vendor is not fully specified

campaign_summary: This outbound call campaign targets active TELUS postpaid primary subscribers who are French-speaking and scored in AAL recommendation tiers 1 through 5 (PREDICT_MODL_ID = 2008, ADD_A_LINE model), promoting the addition of a new mobile line to their existing account. Customers who have added a line within the past 60 days are excluded, as are those in high-risk credit classes (L, C, E, V, X, K) and the Universal Control Group holdout. Calls are dialed by TI Morocco and PL Telecom, with call DNC, stop-sell, and CASTL compliance suppression applied as standard defaults.
